title: Optional experiment_id must be checked with 'is not None', not truthiness
answers: gateway endpoint created with experiment 0 has no experiment linked
empty experiment_id accepted silently when creating a gateway endpoint
usage tracking enabled but experiment is null
body:
Invariant: In gateway endpoint create, an omitted experiment_id is None; any other supplied value, including integer 0 or "", must go through the parser. Test with `is not None`, not truthiness.
Enforced in: mlflow/store/tracking/gateway/sqlalchemy_mixin.py:create_gateway_endpoint (experiment_id=_parse_experiment_id(experiment_id) if experiment_id is not None else None) and update_gateway_endpoint (if experiment_id is not None).
What breaks if skipped: A truthiness check turns integer 0 into null, so the endpoint silently has no experiment while usage_tracking is still True. An empty string is never rejected as invalid.
Constraints: The string "0" is a valid experiment ID and must be stored as experiment "0". Empty string must raise INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.
applies: Any optional integer-like ID field in SQL store create/update paths where 0 or "" are legal inputs.
says: Gateway endpoints created with default experiment zero show no linked experiment in tracking
Saving an empty experiment identifier on a gateway route should display a validation error
Endpoint usage tracking is active but the associated experiment remains empty for experiment zero
Updating an AI gateway endpoint to experiment zero drops the experiment link
search: Optional experiment_id fields in gateway endpoint creation and updates must be validated using is not None instead of truthiness checks. Enforced in mlflow/store/tracking/gateway/sqlalchemy_mixin.py:create_gateway_endpoint and update_gateway_endpoint with mlflow/utils/validation.py:_parse_experiment_id, an omitted ID remains None while supplied values like 0 or "" are parsed. The string "0" must be preserved as experiment "0" to prevent usage tracking from having a null experiment, while an empty string must raise INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.
